Search a catalogue for scenes

cl_search.Rd

Queries a STAC API and returns a normalised item table. Provider-specific property names are translated to a common vocabulary so that downstream code never branches on the backend.

Usage

cl_search(aoi, sensor, start, end, max_cloud = 100, limit = 500, backend =
  NULL, retries = 3L, extra = list())

Arguments

aoi

Area of interest: a numeric bounding box c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) in degrees, or an sf object.

sensor

Sensor id or alias.

start

Date range.

end

Date range.

max_cloud

Maximum scene cloud cover in percent.

limit

Maximum items to return; Inf fetches all pages.

backend

Catalogue backend.

retries

Number of attempts per HTTP request before giving up. Retries are applied to each page individually, with exponential backoff and respect for any Retry-After header. This matters more than it sounds: a large query spans many pages, and retrying the whole query after a failure on the last page discards every page already fetched and hits the service harder each time.

extra

Additional STAC query fields.

Value

A data frame of class cl_items with columns id, datetime, sensor, platform, cloud_cover, path_row or tile, geometry_bbox and assets.
